title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 34
description: Ten questions on Numbers 34: the borders of the land of Canaan and the men chosen to divide it.

questions.text: The south border was to start from the end of which sea?
questions.explanation: The south border was to be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.

questions.text: From Azmon, where did the south border turn to before ending at the sea?
questions.explanation: The border turned about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it ended at the sea.

questions.text: What was to be Israel's western border?
questions.explanation: For the western border they would have the great sea and its border.

questions.text: From Mount Hor, the north border was to be marked out to which place?
questions.explanation: From Mount Hor they were to mark out the border to the entrance of Hamath, passing by Zedad.

questions.text: On the east border, the line went down from Shepham to which place?
questions.explanation: The border was to go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain.

questions.text: Along which river did the east border go down to end at the Salt Sea?
questions.explanation: The border was to go down to the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea.

questions.text: Besides the half-tribe, to how many tribes was the land to be given by lot?
questions.explanation: Moses said it was the land which Yahweh commanded to give to the nine tribes and to the half-tribe.

questions.text: Which tribes had already received their inheritance beyond the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh had received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward.

answers.text: Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh

questions.text: Which two men did Yahweh name first to divide the land for inheritance?
questions.explanation: The men who would divide the land were Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.

questions.text: Who was chosen as the prince from the tribe of Judah?
questions.explanation: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh was named.
